blocks.zh: Topic 2：品質源於設計（QbD）原則
blocks.en: Topic 2: Quality by Design (QbD) Principles

blocks.zh: 本章學習目標
blocks.en: Learning Objectives

blocks.zh: 理解 Quality-by-Design (QbD)（品質源於設計）的核心理念與 ICH Q8/Q9/Q10 的關聯，以及如何應用於病毒載體與質體的開發。
blocks.en: Understand the core concept of Quality by Design (QbD) and its relationship to ICH Q8/Q9/Q10, and how it is applied to the development of viral vectors and plasmids.

blocks.zh: 掌握 QbD 交付成果的完整鏈條：QTPP → CQA → CMA → CPP → 控制策略 → 製程能力 → 持續改善。
blocks.en: Grasp the complete chain of QbD deliverables: QTPP → CQA → CMA → CPP → control strategy → process capability → continual improvement.

blocks.zh: 釐清在 CRO/CMO 合作模式下，MAH（行銷授權持有人）與外包夥伴各自的責任邊界，尤其是智慧財產（IP）協議的重要性。
blocks.en: Clarify the boundaries of responsibility between the MAH (marketing authorization holder) and the outsourcing partner in a CRO/CMO collaboration model, in particular the importance of intellectual property (IP) agreements.

blocks.zh: 了解當公司外購（而非自行生產）病毒載體或質體時，QbD 原則如何以「階段適當」方式適用，包括關鍵起始原料的規格要求與供應商管理。
blocks.en: Understand how QbD principles apply in a "phase-appropriate" manner when a company purchases (rather than manufactures) viral vectors or plasmids, including specification requirements for critical starting materials and supplier management.

blocks.zh: Q 2.1 — What is QbD and how does it apply to viral vectors and plasmids? Q 2.1 — 何為品質源於設計？如何應用於病毒載體與質體？
blocks.en: Q 2.1 - What is QbD and how does it apply to viral vectors and plasmids?

blocks.en: Original Text

blocks.zh: 導師解析 Tutorial Commentary
blocks.en: Tutorial Commentary

blocks.zh: 核心概念解析 — QbD 交付成果體系
blocks.en: Key Concepts: The QbD Deliverables System

blocks.zh: QbD 並不是一個單一工具，而是一套環環相扣的知識建構體系。理解每個交付成果之間的因果關係，是掌握整個品質體系的關鍵：
blocks.en: QbD is not a single tool but a set of interlocking knowledge-building elements. Understanding the cause-and-effect relationships between the deliverables is the key to mastering the whole quality system:

blocks.zh: QTPP（品質目標產品特性）：由 MAH/Sponsor 定義，描述「這個產品最終要達到什麼樣的品質標準才能安全有效地用於病人」。它是所有後續工作的起點。
blocks.en: QTPP (Quality Target Product Profile): defined by the MAH/Sponsor, it describes "what quality standard the product must ultimately meet in order to be used safely and effectively in patients". It is the starting point of all subsequent work.

blocks.zh: CQA（關鍵品質屬性）：從 QTPP 推導出來，代表那些若超出範圍就會顯著影響產品安全性、效力或純度的物化、生物特性。
blocks.en: CQA (Critical Quality Attribute): derived from the QTPP, it represents those physical, chemical, and biological characteristics that, if outside the range, would significantly affect product safety, potency, or purity.

blocks.zh: CMA（關鍵物料屬性）：原料（例如輔料、起始原料）的哪些特性會影響 CQA？這是產品設計的核心問題。
blocks.en: CMA (Critical Material Attribute): which characteristics of materials (for example excipients and starting materials) affect the CQAs? This is the core question of product design.

blocks.zh: CPP（關鍵製程參數）：製程中哪些操作參數（溫度、pH、感染複數 MOI 等）直接影響 CQA？這是製程設計的核心問題。
blocks.en: CPP (Critical Process Parameter): which operating parameters in the process (temperature, pH, multiplicity of infection MOI, etc.) directly affect the CQAs? This is the core question of process design.

blocks.zh: 控制策略（Control Strategy）：把上述所有連結寫成可執行的管控框架，確保每一批產品的 CQA 都在可接受範圍內。
blocks.en: Control Strategy: writes all of the links above into an executable control framework, ensuring that the CQAs of every batch of product are within the acceptable range.

blocks.zh: 整個鏈條：QTPP → CQA → CMA / CPP → 控制策略 → 製程能力 → 持續改善，是一個循環而非線性的系統。
blocks.en: The whole chain, QTPP → CQA → CMA / CPP → control strategy → process capability → continual improvement, is a cycle rather than a linear system.

blocks.zh: 比喻說明 — 建築藍圖比喻
blocks.en: Analogy: The Architectural Blueprint

blocks.zh: 傳統的品質管控方式就像「先蓋好房子，再叫驗屋員來挑毛病」——品質是在最後才被「檢查」出來的。這種方式在 ATMP 的世界中代價極高：一批病毒載體可能造價數百萬美元，若驗收失敗，損失無法挽回。
blocks.en: The traditional approach to quality control is like "build the house first, then call an inspector to find fault with it", so quality is only "inspected in" at the very end. In the world of ATMPs this is extremely costly: a single batch of viral vector can cost millions of dollars to produce, and if it fails acceptance the loss cannot be recovered.

blocks.zh: QbD 的思維則是：「在畫設計藍圖的時候，就把所有的安全標準、結構要求、電氣規範全部設計進去。」這樣一來，施工過程中每一個步驟都有明確的品質邊界，出問題時也能快速定位根本原因，而不是在出貨前才驚慌失措。
blocks.en: The QbD mindset is: "when drawing the design blueprint, design in all of the safety standards, structural requirements, and electrical codes." In this way every step of construction has clear quality boundaries, and when a problem arises the root cause can be located quickly, instead of panicking just before shipment.

blocks.zh: 對於病毒載體而言，QTPP 就是「建築許可書」，CQA 是「結構安全要求」，CPP 是「施工規範」，控制策略是「驗收標準清單」。
blocks.en: For a viral vector, the QTPP is the "building permit", the CQAs are the "structural safety requirements", the CPPs are the "construction specifications", and the control strategy is the "acceptance checklist".

blocks.zh: 重點提示 — Stage Gates（階段關卡）
blocks.en: Key Point: Stage Gates

blocks.zh: PtC-11 特別強調：在每個臨床開發階段結束時（Phase I → II → III → 商業化），都應設立 stage gate 來重新審查 QTPP、控制策略與管控範圍。這並不是繁文縟節，而是因為：
blocks.en: PtC-11 specifically emphasizes that a stage gate should be set at the end of each clinical development phase (Phase I → II → III → commercial) to re-review the QTPP, the control strategy, and the scope of controls. This is not red tape, but is needed because:

blocks.zh: 早期開發時的知識是有限的，許多 CQA 和 CPP 是基於假設或少量數據所定義的。
blocks.en: Knowledge in early development is limited, and many CQAs and CPPs are defined on the basis of assumptions or a small amount of data.

blocks.zh: 隨著更多批次累積，對製程的理解加深，控制範圍應該被精煉（而非放寬）。
blocks.en: As more batches accumulate and process understanding deepens, the control ranges should be refined (not relaxed).

blocks.zh: 最終的控制策略應在 PPQ（製程性能確效）完成後完成最後一次修訂，然後進入持續改善（lifecycle maintenance）階段。
blocks.en: The final control strategy should receive its last revision after PPQ (process performance qualification) is completed, and then enter the lifecycle maintenance stage.

blocks.zh: 若跳過 stage gate，可能導致後期發現 CQA 定義不足，需要進行昂貴的比較性研究才能向監管機關說明。
blocks.en: If a stage gate is skipped, an inadequately defined CQA may be discovered late, requiring expensive comparability studies to explain it to the regulator.

blocks.zh: 練習思考 Practice Questions
blocks.en: Practice Questions

blocks.zh: 假設您正在開發一種腺相關病毒（AAV）載體用於基因治療，請嘗試列出至少三項您認為屬於 CQA 的屬性，並說明為什麼它們對患者安全或產品效力至關重要。
blocks.en: Suppose you are developing an adeno-associated virus (AAV) vector for gene therapy. List at least three attributes that you consider to be CQAs, and explain why they are critical to patient safety or product potency.

blocks.zh: PtC-11 指出 stage gate 應在「每個開發階段結束時」重新審查控制策略。請問：若一家 CDMO 承接了從 Phase II 到商業化的技術轉移案，他們應在何時、以何種方式完成這個 stage gate 審查？
blocks.en: PtC-11 states that the control strategy should be re-reviewed at a stage gate "at the end of each development phase". If a CDMO takes on a technology transfer project from Phase II through to commercialization, when and how should it complete this stage gate review?

blocks.zh: Q 2.2 — MAH responsibilities when working with a CRO or CMO Q 2.2 — 與 CRO 或 CMO 合作時 MAH 的責任
blocks.en: Q 2.2 - MAH responsibilities when working with a CRO or CMO

blocks.zh: 重點提示 — IP 所有權：最容易被忽視的法律風險
blocks.en: Key Point: IP Ownership, the Most Easily Overlooked Legal Risk

blocks.zh: PtC-11 的這段警告非常直白：「若未事先明訂 IP 協議，成功的產品可能在法律上難以繼續推進。」
blocks.en: This passage of PtC-11 is very direct: "If an IP agreement is not specified in advance, a successful product may be legally difficult to take forward."

blocks.zh: 在 ATMP 領域，這個風險特別真實，原因是：
blocks.en: In the ATMP field this risk is especially real, for the following reasons:

blocks.zh: 許多 Sponsor 在早期臨床階段依賴外部 CRO 開發分析方法（例如病毒滴定法、效價測試），這些方法往往是 CRO 的核心技術資產。
blocks.en: In early clinical stages many Sponsors rely on an external CRO to develop analytical methods (for example virus titration and potency assays), and these methods are often the CRO's core technology assets.

blocks.zh: 若 Quality Agreement 沒有明確規定 MAH 有權存取、使用或取得這些方法，當 MAH 想轉換供應商或自行生產時，就可能面臨法律訴訟或被 CRO 要挾。
blocks.en: If the Quality Agreement does not explicitly state that the MAH has the right to access, use, or obtain these methods, then when the MAH wants to switch suppliers or manufacture in-house it may face litigation or be held to ransom by the CRO.

blocks.zh: 監管機關（如 EMA、FDA）在審查上市申請時，會要求提交完整的分析方法驗證報告——若 MAH 沒有這些文件的存取權，申請可能無法完成。
blocks.en: When reviewing a marketing application, regulators (such as the EMA and FDA) require submission of complete analytical method validation reports; if the MAH has no access to these documents, the application may be unable to be completed.

blocks.zh: 實務建議：在 Quality Agreement 中明確列明：資料所有權、方法使用授權、原始數據存取權、以及供應商倒閉或終止合作時的數據移交條款。
blocks.en: Practical advice: state explicitly in the Quality Agreement: data ownership, licensing of method use, access to raw data, and data transfer provisions in the event of supplier bankruptcy or termination of the collaboration.

blocks.zh: 實務應用 — CDMO 視角：技術承接前的核查清單
blocks.en: Practical Application, CDMO Perspective: Checklist Before Taking Over a Technology

blocks.zh: 身為 CDMO 的接收方，在簽署技術轉移協議之前，應確認以下事項已從 MAH 取得：
blocks.en: As the receiving party, a CDMO should confirm that the following have been obtained from the MAH before signing the technology transfer agreement:

blocks.zh: QTPP 文件：確認已明確定義產品的目標品質特性（劑型、效力、純度標準等）。
blocks.en: QTPP document: confirm that the target quality characteristics of the product (dosage form, potency, purity criteria, etc.) have been clearly defined.

blocks.zh: CQA 清單及風險評估依據：每一個 CQA 應有對應的科學理由說明。
blocks.en: CQA list and the basis of the risk assessment: each CQA should have a corresponding scientific rationale.

blocks.zh: 所有 CPP 及其可接受範圍（proven acceptable range, PAR）：這些是製程開發研究的核心輸出。
blocks.en: All CPPs and their proven acceptable ranges (PAR): these are the core outputs of process development studies.

blocks.zh: 分析方法轉移計畫：包括方法的 SOP、驗證報告、以及可接受標準。
blocks.en: Analytical method transfer plan: including the method SOPs, validation reports, and acceptance criteria.

blocks.zh: 前期批次歷史（batch history）：用於建立初始製程能力基準（benchmark）。
blocks.en: Prior batch history: used to establish the initial process capability benchmark.

blocks.zh: 若以上任何一項缺失，CDMO 應在合約簽署前要求補充，否則將承擔不必要的開發風險與法規風險。
blocks.en: If any of the above is missing, the CDMO should require it to be supplied before the contract is signed; otherwise it will bear unnecessary development risk and regulatory risk.

blocks.zh: 一家新創 Sponsor 委託 CRO 開發 AAV 轉染方法，但忘記在 Quality Agreement 中約定 IP 歸屬。三年後，CRO 拒絕提供方法驗證文件，導致上市申請受阻。請問 Sponsor 應如何在一開始就避免這個困境？具體應在 Quality Agreement 中加入哪些條款？
blocks.en: A start-up Sponsor commissions a CRO to develop an AAV transfection method but forgets to agree on IP ownership in the Quality Agreement. Three years later, the CRO refuses to provide the method validation documents, and the marketing application is blocked. How should the Sponsor have avoided this predicament from the start? Specifically, which clauses should be added to the Quality Agreement?

blocks.zh: PtC-11 引用了 PDA TR 65（技術轉移）作為參考。請問技術轉移協議（technology transfer protocol）與製程驗證計畫（process validation plan）之間有什麼關係？兩者各涵蓋哪些核心內容？
blocks.en: PtC-11 cites PDA TR 65 (technology transfer) as a reference. What is the relationship between a technology transfer protocol and a process validation plan? What core content does each cover?

blocks.zh: 核心概念解析 — MAH vs CRO/CMO 責任邊界
blocks.en: Key Concepts: Division of Responsibilities between the MAH and the CRO/CMO

blocks.zh: 在 ATMP 的開發與生產鏈中，責任的分配並非隨意協商的結果，而是有監管框架約束的。PtC-11 清楚說明了幾個不可委外的核心責任（以 MAH 為主）：
blocks.en: In the ATMP development and manufacturing chain, the allocation of responsibilities is not the result of arbitrary negotiation but is bound by the regulatory framework. PtC-11 makes clear several core responsibilities that cannot be outsourced (mainly those of the MAH):

blocks.zh: Q 2.3 — QbD when sourcing (not manufacturing) viral vectors or plasmids Q 2.3 — 採購（非自製）病毒載體或質體時的品質源於設計
blocks.en: Q 2.3 - QbD when sourcing (not manufacturing) viral vectors or plasmids

blocks.zh: 核心概念解析 — 身份測試（Identity Testing）是最低 GMP 要求
blocks.en: Key Concepts: Identity Testing Is the Minimum GMP Requirement

blocks.zh: 無論起始原料的監管分類為何，身份測試（identity testing）是所有 GMP 環境下不可豁免的最低要求。這背後的邏輯很直觀：你必須能夠確認「這個東西確實是我訂購的東西」，否則一切品質管控都是空談。
blocks.en: Whatever the regulatory classification of the starting material, identity testing is the minimum requirement that cannot be waived in any GMP setting. The logic behind this is intuitive: you must be able to confirm that "this is indeed what I ordered", otherwise all quality control is empty talk.

blocks.zh: 對於病毒載體與質體，身份測試的方法需要視開發階段（phase-appropriate GMP）來決定其深度：
blocks.en: For viral vectors and plasmids, the depth of the identity testing method depends on the development phase (phase-appropriate GMP):

blocks.zh: 早期臨床（Phase I/II）：部分序列分析（partial sequencing）通常就足以確認身份，不需要全長序列測定。
blocks.en: Early clinical (Phase I/II): partial sequencing is usually sufficient to confirm identity, and full-length sequencing is not required.

blocks.zh: 晚期臨床至商業化（Phase III+）：可能需要更完整的序列確認與功能性測試，以支持上市申請。
blocks.en: Late clinical to commercial (Phase III+): more complete sequence confirmation and functional testing may be needed to support the marketing application.

blocks.zh: 純度、效價、功能性、病毒安全性等測試，雖然也是重要要求，但可以透過風險評估來決定是否採用供應商 CoA 代替自行測試——前提是供應商已通過完整的資格認定稽核。
blocks.en: Tests for purity, potency, functionality, viral safety, and so on are also important requirements, but through risk assessment it can be decided whether to rely on the supplier CoA in place of in-house testing, provided that the supplier has passed a full qualification audit.

blocks.zh: 比喻說明 — 食材採購比喻
blocks.en: Analogy: Sourcing Ingredients

blocks.zh: 想像一家頂級餐廳向外部農場購買食材，而不是自己種植。即使農場負責種植，餐廳仍然必須：
blocks.en: Imagine a top restaurant that buys ingredients from an outside farm instead of growing them itself. Even though the farm does the growing, the restaurant must still:

blocks.zh: 在收貨時確認「這確實是我訂的有機番茄，不是其他品種」（身份測試）。
blocks.en: Confirm on receipt that "these are indeed the organic tomatoes I ordered, not another variety" (identity testing).

blocks.zh: 要求農場提供農藥殘留報告、產地證明（CoA / CoC）。
blocks.en: Require the farm to provide pesticide residue reports and certificates of origin (CoA / CoC).

blocks.zh: 定期親自去農場視察（onsite audit），而不只是看報告。
blocks.en: Visit the farm in person periodically (onsite audit), and not just read the reports.

blocks.zh: 在農場改變種植方式之前，要提前通知餐廳（change control）。
blocks.en: Be notified in advance, before the farm changes its growing method (change control).

blocks.zh: 若農場擁有獨家種植配方（IP），餐廳或許無法得知全部細節，但至少要知道足夠的資訊來確保食品安全——監管機關（衛生局）也會直接去農場稽查，不只是稽查餐廳。
blocks.en: If the farm holds an exclusive growing recipe (IP), the restaurant may not be able to know every detail, but must at least know enough to ensure food safety; the regulator (the health department) will also inspect the farm directly, not just the restaurant.

blocks.zh: 重點提示 — 供應商持有 IP 時，現場稽核仍是強制要求
blocks.en: Key Point: When the Supplier Holds the IP, an Onsite Audit Is Still Mandatory

blocks.zh: PtC-11 明確指出：即使供應商以 IP 保護為由，不願意揭露完整的製程細節，現場稽核（onsite auditing）仍然是必要的。這是因為：
blocks.en: PtC-11 states explicitly that even if a supplier is unwilling to disclose full process details on the grounds of IP protection, onsite auditing is still necessary. This is because:

blocks.zh: 監管機關（如 EMA、FDA）可能要求檢視原始源數據（original source data），這些數據只能在現場才能核查。
blocks.en: Regulators (such as the EMA and FDA) may require inspection of original source data, which can only be verified on site.

blocks.zh: 品質協議（Quality Agreement）中應明訂 MAH 有權進行現場稽核的條款，即使供應商持有 IP。
blocks.en: The Quality Agreement should include a clause giving the MAH the right to conduct onsite audits, even when the supplier holds the IP.

blocks.zh: 部分監管機關保留對供應商設施進行基於風險之稽查的權力——MAH 必須確保供應商有此準備。
blocks.en: Some regulators retain the authority to conduct risk-based inspections of supplier facilities; the MAH must make sure the supplier is prepared for this.

blocks.zh: 若供應商拒絕接受現場稽核，這本身就是一個重大的供應商資格危險訊號（red flag），MAH 應重新評估是否繼續合作。
blocks.en: If a supplier refuses to accept an onsite audit, this in itself is a major red flag in supplier qualification, and the MAH should reassess whether to continue the collaboration.

blocks.zh: 實務應用 — Quality Agreement 中的變更通知條款
blocks.en: Practical Application: Change Notification Clauses in the Quality Agreement

blocks.zh: PtC-11 要求：無論向量或質體是被分類為藥物活性成份還是起始原料，Quality Agreement 中都必須建立供應商的變更控制通知義務。
blocks.en: PtC-11 requires that, whether the vector or plasmid is classified as a drug substance or as a starting material, the Quality Agreement must establish the supplier's change control notification obligations.

blocks.zh: 在 CDMO 環境中，建議在 Quality Agreement 中明確涵蓋以下變更通知情境：
blocks.en: In a CDMO setting, it is recommended that the Quality Agreement explicitly cover the following change notification scenarios:

blocks.zh: 產品層面：序列修改、轉殖策略變更、新細胞株的引入。
blocks.en: Product level: sequence modifications, changes in the cloning strategy, introduction of a new cell line.

blocks.zh: 製程層面：培養基成分變更、純化步驟的調整、設備更換。
blocks.en: Process level: changes in culture medium composition, adjustments to purification steps, equipment replacement.

blocks.zh: 分析層面：任何用於放行測試之方法的修改或取代。
blocks.en: Analytical level: any modification or replacement of a method used for release testing.

blocks.zh: 設施層面：生產地點變更、GMP 分類降級或升級。
blocks.en: Facility level: change of manufacturing site, downgrade or upgrade of the GMP classification.

blocks.zh: 通知時限的建議：重大變更應在實施前至少 60 天通知 MAH；緊急變更應立即通知並在事後補充文件說明。
blocks.en: Recommended notification timelines: major changes should be notified to the MAH at least 60 days before implementation; urgent changes should be notified immediately, with supporting documentation supplied afterwards.

blocks.zh: 一家 Sponsor 正在採購一批外部供應商提供的 AAV 質體，供應商聲稱此質體受 IP 保護，因此拒絕提供完整的製程說明。Sponsor 應如何在保護供應商 IP 的前提下，仍然滿足監管機關的技術審查要求？請列出至少三個可行的策略。
blocks.en: A Sponsor is purchasing a batch of AAV plasmids from an external supplier. The supplier claims the plasmid is IP-protected and therefore refuses to provide a full process description. How can the Sponsor still meet the regulator's technical review requirements while protecting the supplier's IP? List at least three feasible strategies.

blocks.zh: PtC-11 建議將關鍵起始原料「建庫（banked）」。請解釋「建庫」在這個情境中的具體含義，並說明它如何降低供應鏈中斷或材料混淆的風險。
blocks.en: PtC-11 recommends that critical starting materials be "banked". Explain what "banking" means in this context, and how it reduces the risk of supply chain interruption or material mix-up.

blocks.zh: 本節重點回顧 Section Summary
blocks.en: Section Summary

blocks.zh: QbD 是一個系統，不是一份文件：其核心鏈條 QTPP → CQA → CMA → CPP → 控制策略，在每個開發階段應透過 stage gate 進行迭代更新，最終於 PPQ 結束後完成定稿，並進入終身維護（lifecycle maintenance）。
blocks.en: QbD is a system, not a document: its core chain QTPP → CQA → CMA → CPP → control strategy should be updated iteratively through stage gates at each development phase, finalized after PPQ is completed, and then move into lifecycle maintenance.

blocks.zh: MAH 的責任無法被完全委外：即使與 CRO/CMO 合作，Sponsor/MAH 仍須主導 QTPP 定義、定期查核記錄、保留資料與 IP 的存取權。IP 協議若缺失，可能導致成功產品無法推進商業化。
blocks.en: The MAH's responsibilities cannot be completely outsourced: even when working with a CRO/CMO, the Sponsor/MAH must still lead the definition of the QTPP, conduct periodic audits and keep records, and retain access to data and IP. Without an IP agreement, a successful product may be unable to advance to commercialization.

blocks.zh: 外購原料的 QbD 適用性取決於監管分類：被認定為藥物活性成份者需符合 CMO 要求；被認定為關鍵起始原料者，至少需有進廠規格、身份測試與合格供應商稽核。
blocks.en: The applicability of QbD to purchased materials depends on regulatory classification: those classified as drug substances must meet the CMO requirements; those classified as critical starting materials need, at a minimum, incoming material specifications, identity testing, and a qualified supplier audit.

blocks.zh: 現場稽核是不可妥協的要求：即使供應商持有 IP，MAH 仍須對關鍵供應商進行嚴格現場稽核，並確保 Quality Agreement 中包含完善的變更通知條款，以保護臨床試驗或上市申請不受供應商單方面變更的衝擊。
blocks.en: Onsite audits are a non-negotiable requirement: even if the supplier holds the IP, the MAH must still conduct rigorous onsite audits of critical suppliers and make sure the Quality Agreement contains sound change notification clauses, to protect the clinical trial or marketing application from unilateral supplier changes.

blocks.zh: 參考文件：PDA TR 56（階段適當品質體系）、PDA TR 65（技術轉移）、ICH Q8(R2)、ICH Q9、ICH Q10、EMA Reflection Paper on GMP and MAH。
blocks.en: References: PDA TR 56 (phase-appropriate quality systems), PDA TR 65 (technology transfer), ICH Q8(R2), ICH Q9, ICH Q10, EMA Reflection Paper on GMP and MAH.
